label: POST HOC: pending outcomes were read (2026-10-20) before this uncertainty model was built (2026-10-21); the recipe came from the training fit and its cross-validation and was not tuned on these rows
recipe: sigma_center = sqrt(sigma_stat^2 + sigma_model^2); a hyperfine component adds sigma_HF = sqrt(a^2 + (kappa o)^2) (o its offset from the center); an intraline interval Delta has sqrt(2 a^2 + (kappa Delta)^2) alone. sigma_stat: the sandwich covariance of the weighted Gauss-Newton estimator at final_rx over the 39 new terms (B:dDe = X:dDe), the 47 frozen core potential coefficients, 7 inherited dispersion log factors (prior 0.1) and 5 calibrations (priors: their own fits), each data category scaled by its Birge ratio (at least 1), from the SVD of the weighted Jacobian (directions below 1e-8 of the largest singular value dropped); propagated through Hellmann-Feynman level derivatives. sigma_model: fitted by marginal likelihood to held-out center residuals (research-balanced core folds; finalcv_vmod40-43), measurement sigmas removed in quadrature (atlases and constants scaled by their in-sample Birge ratios), each held-out level a random effect; core per line in two classes (both levels within 15 in J of a precision training row at their v, or not); beyond the core per level, exp(a + b (v - v0) + c (min(J, J_clip)/100)^2), X with b, c >= 0. sigma_HF: Gaussian likelihood on held-out intraline intervals (core folds; nested hyperfine CV beyond, with its held-out Chen 2004 / Pique 1986 eqQ converted through |eqQ' - eqQ''|) and, for X beyond, the emission components' within-line scatter; kappa held at its last validated v beyond. Status of a level: measured (training rows within 15 in J at its v), interpolated (inside its v's J range, or between neighbors within 2 in v), else extrapolated.
note: z = residual / sqrt(sigma_model^2 + sigma_meas^2); P(13) 43-0 is diagnostic only; 129I2 targets have no balanced-expanded prediction. The "seen" and "superseded" rows reach training through compilations or re-measurements and are not independent of the fit.
